facts.fact: NIRA has completed migration of its national ID records to the open-source MOSIP platform.
facts.system: NIRA national identity platform on MOSIP

facts.fact: NIRA itself built into the system the capability to issue two distinct ID cards, one for citizens and one for foreign nationals, to comply with Ugandan law.
